rule: Kill-triggered avengers, companion-triggered hive reactions, a rare relic whose timer shrinks per kill, a raid-boss clock (random window or weekly slot) with a persisted status, a per-zone time bank, and a Balok ledger shell (PARTIAL). See the md note for the order of operations per cell.

cells.name: Kill-site avenger (three area scripts)
cells.best_transferable_idea: A kill that rolls for a replacement body that hunts the killer for five minutes.
cells.defect: Cemetery.cs:49 and FieldOfMassacre.cs:51 (and LairOfAntharasPytan.cs:37) delete the killed NPC even when the avenger spawn returned null; fix: delete only on success.

cells.name: Companion-reactive hive
cells.best_transferable_idea: A companion hit on a hive monster sets a buff, and a kill can call an avenger that goes for the companion.
cells.defect: BeeHive.cs:86 scans visible monsters for an existing avenger, so leaving view allows a second one; fix: store the live avenger id on the player state.

cells.name: Cursed relic with a shrinking timer
cells.decision: adapt (idea), level defect fixed in the sketch
cells.best_transferable_idea: A rare drop whose timer shrinks with each kill the carrier makes, with a coin flip on the carrier's death.
cells.defect: giveSkill (CursedWeapon.cs:259) and getLevel (CursedWeapon.cs:622) disagree by one; giveSkill throws when the skill row is missing; poll period labelled minutes but runs at 12 s per unit.

cells.name: Raid-boss clock and grand-boss store
cells.decision: adapt (idea), pattern defect fixed in the sketch
cells.best_transferable_idea: A dead boss shows DEAD until a clock runs out; most clocks are a random window, a few are a fixed weekly slot.
cells.defect: SchedulingPattern.next() throws NotImplementedException (SchedulingPattern.cs:16) and the two weekly bosses call it on death (DBSpawnManager.cs:187); the pattern path also overwrites a pending future without cancelling (DBSpawnManager.cs:204-210); min and max multipliers apply separately (DBSpawnManager.cs:194-195).

cells.name: Timed hunting zone time bank
cells.best_transferable_idea: A per-zone time bank that survives leaving and resumes on re-entry.
cells.defect: none found in the code read; reset and refill not read.

cells.name: Balok boss-war ledger
cells.decision: adapt only after the writers exist
cells.best_transferable_idea: A personal rank and capped top list over one shared score, with the writers still missing.
cells.defect: no caller writes the score, stage, war state or reward flag (grep on the L2Dn tree); BALOK_AVAILABLE_REWARD is read and cleared but never set to 1.
